name: activityops
description: ActivityOps - operator-facing business-site verification system (Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026, Ring track)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run serve --workspace apps/api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
